app.name: Tenancy
app.tagline: Rent and repairs, in one shared record

common.photoTypes: JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB
common.demoNote: This is a front-end prototype. Data is sample data and nothing is saved.

landing.title: Track rent and repairs in one place
landing.subtitle: Landlords and tenants in Bahrain share one record of every payment, receipt and maintenance request.
landing.f1: See which months are paid, due or late at a glance.
landing.f2: A receipt is created for every confirmed payment.
landing.f3: Report damage with a photo and follow the repair.
landing.oneAccount: One account works for both landlords and tenants.

auth.loginSub: Log in to see your properties and leases.
auth.createSub: You can rent out a property, rent a home, or both.
auth.errWrong: Wrong email or password. Check your password and try again.
auth.errEmail: Enter a valid email address, like name@email.com.
auth.errPassword: Password must be at least 8 characters.
auth.demo: Demo: use any email with the password tenancy123.
auth.verifyText: We sent a verification link to {{email}}. Open it to activate your account.
auth.resent: A new link is on its way.
auth.resetText: Enter the email you registered with and we'll send you a reset link.
auth.resetSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.

welcome.title: What would you like to do?
welcome.sub: Pick one to start. You can do both later with the same account.
welcome.landlordText: Add your property, invite your tenant and track rent.
welcome.tenantText: Accept your landlord's invite to see your lease and pay rent.

landlord.emptyText: Add your first property to invite a tenant and start tracking rent.
landlord.errPropName: Enter a name for the property.

property.tenantEmailHint: We'll email them an invite link.
property.inviteSent: Invite sent to {{email}}. The lease shows Pending until they accept.
property.errDates: End date must be after the start date.

rent.rejectText: The tenant will see your reason and can upload a new proof.
rent.errReason: Give a reason so the tenant knows what to fix.
rent.confirmed: Payment confirmed. A receipt was created.
rent.rejectedMsg: Payment rejected. The tenant has been told why.

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.statementText: Every payment for this lease in one PDF.
receipts.empty: Receipts appear here after a payment is confirmed.

requests.title: Maintenance requests
requests.replyPh: e.g. A plumber will visit on Thursday morning.
requests.updated: Update saved. The tenant has been notified.
requests.descriptionPh: Where is it and since when?
requests.errPhoto: Add at least one photo of the damage.
requests.sent: Request sent. Your landlord has been notified.
requests.statusHelp: Submitted → Accepted → In progress → Fixed. The tenant is notified at each step.

tenant.inviteTitle: You've been invited to a lease
tenant.inviteText: {{name}} invited you to this lease. Check the details match your paper contract.
tenant.howToPay: Pay by bank transfer as usual, then upload the proof here so your landlord can confirm it.
tenant.errFile: Upload a screenshot or PDF of the transfer.
tenant.submittedText: Your landlord will check it. The month shows Pending until then.

settings.title: Settings
settings.oneSettings: These settings apply to both landlord and tenant mode.

profile.title: Profile
profile.emailNote: Changing your email sends a new verification link.

notifs.title: Notifications
notifs.remindersText: Before rent is due, when it's late, and when a request changes.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The page you're looking for doesn't exist.
